en: Colorized historic postcard showing a large Gothic church with a polygonal apse, tall pointed windows, and a steep red roof with a slender spire in front of a taller tower with a bulbous Baroque dome and clock. In the foreground there is an open-air market with rows of stalls under white canopies in a town square. Printed captions at the bottom identify the place and publisher.
